review: CurrentOriginalCenters keeps its original image decode cache and source-pixel transform, accepting optional marker records assembled only from existing verified centers. Native painter paths hit actual marker circles; no inverse cell projection is added. One hit emits the exact combo key; multiple hits use a native nonblocking QMenu. Tooltip/menu/cursor state clears on source or marker changes and hide. Main and action map pages reuse the same marker view and existing combo selection paths. Per-source marker ordinals agree with their combo indices. Native splitter orientation adapts to width while retaining separate divider sizes. ReferenceWindow reuses screen-placement logic for normal visible resize, fixing the observed offscreen tall window. Exact copy mappings shorten default prose and original main-map prose is retained in technical details. No calibration coordinates, geometry, game arithmetic, retries, catches, data downloads at runtime or game/chat controls were added.
